title: Commitment Studio — weekly sprint scrap
content:
Purpose: informal running scratchpad for my micro-OKRs and weekly commitments. Not polished — this is the place I jot quick signals, small experiments, and decisions to bring into the official OKR doc on Friday.

How I use this file:
- End-of-week quickfire: 6 bullets, 2 minutes.
- Track one experiment per week (short duration, measurable signal).
- Keep a rolling list of blockers and asks for SE and PM sync.

WEEK: 2026-02-22 -> 2026-02-28 snapshot
- Focus theme: reduce per-token latency on small prompt paths (~<=128 tokens).
- Macro OKR thread: Improve latency/throughput economics for hosted small-chat customers.

Personal micro-OKRs (draft, 2–4 week horizon)
Objective A — Shrink median tail latency for short chats by 20%
- KR A1: Deploy small-chat kernel experiment to staging and collect 100k tokens of telemetry. (current: 95k/target: 100k)
- KR A2: Reduce median p95 latency from 260ms -> 210ms on our N-1 hosting tier (measured in real requests).
- KR A3: Document fallback behavior and update route policy widget in console.

Objective B — Improve my throughput in handling CS escalations and rollout requests
- KR B1: Reduce my SLAs backlog from 12->4 items (open tickets I own).
- KR B2: Run 2 knowledge share sessions with support engineers about model-routing policies.

Small experiments (week-level)
1) "Tiny-kernel" experiment (A/B)
- Hypothesis: Switching to the compact attention kernel for seq_len<=128 will reduce p50 by ~10% without raising error rate.
- Measurement: p50/p95, error_count, and cost-per-token for small-chat route. Target telemetry: 100k tokens.
- Action: deploy to canary pool (tag small-chat-canary), enable prefix caching.
- Status: canary deployed 2026-02-24. Telemetry started 02-24.
- Early signal: p50 lowered 9% on canary; p95 unchanged. Need more tokens.

2) KB-caching TTL tweak (quick config)
- Hypothesis: Reduce TTL for ephemeral KB lookups from 600s->120s to reduce stale-context hits during rapid intent flips.
- Risk: increased upstream DB reads.
- Status: rolled to staging config; waiting for stage-run feedback.

Metrics snapshot (personal tracker):
- Tokens processed (week): 137k (goal 150k)
- Tickets closed (week): 5/8 my triage target
- Demos scheduled: 1 (customer: Acme Chat)
- Docs updated this week: rollout-policy-notes.md (draft)

Quick reflections (notes-to-self):
- Need to be stricter about telemetry completeness before calling wins. Too often I shout success after 20k tokens. Aim for 100k where feasible.
- Say no faster: triage meeting took 45m I could have spent finishing the rollout docs. Try 15m standups only.
- Cross-team ask: SRE — can we get a short retention policy for canary traces? Having only 3h retention slows debugging.

Open blockers / asks for Monday sync
- Request to infra: temp quota bump for canary GPUs for bulk telemetry run (JIRA-847 has details).
- Ask to Docs: please sanity-check the rollout-policy wording (links in linked_artifacts).
- PM check: confirm customer acceptance criteria for latency improvement (is p95 or perceived fluidity the metric?).

Decisions made this week
- Acceptable roll-forward: if canary p50 improves >=8% and p95 not worse by >5%, flag for gradual rollout.
- TTL change: hold on production until cost estimate from infra (expected Monday).

Micro action list (next 7 days) — checklist
- [ ] Collect additional 30k tokens on canary (priority)
- [ ] Open a brief memo for SRE re: canary trace retention (2 paragraphs)
- [ ] Update rollout widget copy in console (draft -> in_review)
- [ ] Run 30m knowledge share with Support (schedule w/ Maya)
- [ ] Reconcile tickets: close low-priority items in backlog

Hypotheses to test next sprint (ideation)
- Hypothesis X: KV cache prefetching for recognized conversational intents will reduce p95 more than kernel switching at high concurrency.
- Hypothesis Y: Small quantization variant of the baseline model may reduce cost-per-token by 7% without changing output quality for short chats.

Loose ideas / brainstorm scraps
- Could we expose a "performance profile" toggle in the console for customers to choose small-chat optimized kernels? Quick win for power users.
- Mini-AB test in embedded demos: switch to compact kernel for first N tokens then swap back. Might reduce perceived initial latency.

Random quick notes (unstructured)
- Slack thread: #serving-runtime -> see thread titled "canary-retention" from Feb 24.
- PM asked about demo metrics: capture both system p50/p95 and human-reported perceived lag. Put that on the dashboard.

End-of-week summary (2 lines)
- Small wins: early p50 improvements in canary, docs draft started.
- Biggest risk: insufficient telemetry and quota constraints slowing decision timeline.

If I revisit this file Friday:
- Move stable points into the formal OKR doc and mark completed KRs.
- Publish a 1-paragraph note to the team about the canary early signals.

Notes to self (closing)
- Keep experiments short and measurable. Document the expected failure modes along with the success signal.
- Celebrate small wins with the team (a quick Slack note takes 30s).
